description: A live AWS Glue Data Catalog; credentials from the AWS credential chain (AWS_PROFILE, environment, ...). aws_default_credentials is off: with credentials in the environment the aws extension adds a default secret whose negative match score httpfs's bulk S3 delete can not cast (Information loss on integer cast), so deleting written files fails
on_init: SET aws_default_credentials = false; CREATE SECRET (TYPE S3, PROVIDER credential_chain, REGION 'eu-central-1');
